about: Imodium (loperamide), by brand name only, is supplied eight times from February to September 2026 to a 70-year-old man, with 60 capsules in each pack and directions to take one capsule twice a day. Each pack gives a 30-day course.
Lomotil (diphenoxylate with atropine) is supplied three times from January to February 2026 to a 74-year-old woman, in the middle of a 14-month history.
Loperamide (Gastro-Stop) is supplied once, as a pack of 8 capsules with directions to stop after 2 days, so it is not used for more than 2 days and the criterion is not met.
